plugin.name: s411_pi
plugin.summary: S-411 Ice Information overlay (IHO S-100 ice charts)
plugin.author: s411_pi authors
plugin.description: Loads S-411 Ice Information datasets (Edition 2.0.0/1.x GML, exchange sets, zips) and renders them with the WMO ice chart colour code. Switchable display mode (concentration / stage of development / ice-class traffic light), vessel ice class and day/dusk/night palette, Annex C symbols. Shows the age of the ice information, applies the dataset precedence rules and verifies S-100 signatures. Checks routes for ice, computes ice-aware routes (A* by vessel ice class), exports ice no-go zones for the Weather Routing plugin and downloads the current charts of the ice services. Also reads SIGRID-3 shapefiles.
